VISUAL CONTINUITY BIBLE:

This film belongs to the same continuous cinematic universe.

The digital office is the Mokaid AI Office shown in the reference image:
a premium stylized 3D office environment, slightly isometric but fully volumetric,
dark charcoal architecture, sophisticated violet and electric blue neon floor lighting,
warm amber practical lights, elegant desks, screens, plants, meeting room, coffee area,
lounge area and foosball table.

Keep the exact same architecture, furniture language, lighting palette and spatial identity
throughout every shot.

The AI employees are friendly premium stylized humanoid digital workers.
They are not metallic robots and not cartoon characters.
They look intelligent, approachable, professional and slightly futuristic.
Consistent character design throughout the film.

Cinematic physically plausible camera movement.
Premium global illumination.
Soft volumetric light.
Realistic depth of field.
Subtle motion blur.
High-end commercial cinematography.
No chaotic camera movement.
No sudden geometry changes.
No morphing furniture.
No disappearing characters.
No duplicated characters.
No warped screens.
No text generated inside screens unless specifically requested.

Every shot must feel like the camera is physically travelling through one continuous place.
Smooth acceleration and deceleration.
Elegant ease-in and ease-out camera curves.
No hard cuts unless explicitly requested.

CAMERA MOTION LANGUAGE:
The camera movement must feel designed for interactive website scrollytelling.
Every major movement follows cinematic easing curves:
stillness → gradual acceleration → fluid travel → gradual deceleration → stillness.
No constant-speed robotic camera movement.
Create natural visual resting points where the website can pause the video during scrolling.
Use strong foreground parallax when travelling through the office.
Occasionally pass close to desks, plants, chairs and characters to reinforce depth and immersion.
Movement should feel like a premium interactive experience,
somewhere between an Apple product film, a Pixar environment exploration
and a high-end architectural camera tour.
No shaky camera. No handheld movement. No whip pans. No random zooms. No hard transitions.


SCENE7 — THE OFFICE COMPLETES WORK. ONE modest controlled physical camera move in the SAME COMPACT OFFICE. Start at exact supplied first frame, two coworkers at existing graphite foosball table, dark field/red figures. Violet shirt LEFT, amber sweater RIGHT. Both remain firmly at this exact table the entire10-second take. Their faces, clothes, hands, table, chairs and blue glass room never change. Tiny wrist motions only. No one leaves the table, no other person joins it. No duplication, no table becoming desk, no green playing field.

Camera smoothly eases BACKWARD and gently rises less than one meter with a very small lateral arc, revealing existing nearby working desks. Do NOT travel through new aisles or invent additional desk rows. Foosball remains clearly visible in foreground, coffee counter fixed rear-left, electric blue meeting-room glass fixed rear-right. The move is short, slow and cinematic, ending in EXACT supplied final wide composition with these same2players still at same table. Use given final frame as target camera/view ONLY, never as an instruction to rearrange room.

Work completes in background: existing monitor activity changes to SIMPLE SMALL GREEN CHECKMARKS and completed progress bars one after another. No written text/paragraphs, no floating interface or added objects. Staff at distant existing desks keep working. Violet floor light brightens subtly. Controlled excitement, no frenetic movement. Stillness, graceful acceleration, brief fluid travel, graceful deceleration to stillness. No hard cuts, no dissolves, no sliding furniture or morphing room. Only one office footprint. Sound: soft office keyboard rhythm, subtle tasteful success taps, tiny foosball sounds, quiet rising electronic pulse, no intelligible speech or voiceover.
